name: Jehikhiah
overview: Jehikhiah was a male member of the tribe of Ephraim known for being the son of Shallum. He is noted in Scripture for aiding the defeated Judaites, demonstrating a spirit of assistance and alliance across tribal lines during a time of conflict.
namesAndTitles: The name Jehikhiah means 'YHWH gives strength,' reflecting a powerful affirmation of God's sustaining power. This proper name highlights a recognition of divine support and strength in his life or family.
familyAndRelationships: Jehikhiah is explicitly identified as the son of Shallum. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide further family details for Jehikhiah.
scriptureSignificance: Jehikhiah's significance in the biblical narrative centers on his role in helping the Judaites after their defeat, illustrating a Christ-centered example of mercy and support among God's people. His Ephraimite heritage and actions emphasize the interconnectedness of Israel's tribes under God's providence. Through his assistance, Jehikhiah exemplifies faithfulness to God's people during times of trial.
